images.alt: A true colour satellite image of new zealand at 1:20pm, most of the country is a green and brown patchwork with white peaks visible across the southern alps and central plateau. White cloud lurks along the eastern coast of the north island, and over the sea surrounding the country.

A photo of the wellington waterfront. A kororā plushie sits in the foreground, looking out over the still water of the harbour. Oriental bay and the mirimar peninsula is visible in the distance, all under brilliant blue skies with only a few white clouds.

post.text:
🌞 I hope you're making the most of the afternoon sunshine, we certainly are! 🐧

🥶 The cold winter mornings do come with one benefit, gorgeously clear afternoons. Nearly the entire country is cloud free, with the sole exception of the North Islands eastern coastline.

source.agency_name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand (MetService NZ)
